scenarios.title: Restaurant
scenarios.communicative_objective: Order food, handle a problem with your order and reach a solution with the waiter.
scenarios.prompt: You are in a restaurant and the waiter has brought you the wrong order. Politely explain the problem, ask for a solution and respond naturally to what the waiter says.

scenarios.title: Doctor
scenarios.communicative_objective: Describe your symptoms clearly and understand the doctor's advice and instructions.
scenarios.prompt: You are at the doctor's office. Describe what is wrong, answer the doctor's questions about how you feel and make sure you understand the advice you receive.

scenarios.title: Travel
scenarios.communicative_objective: Ask for and give travel information, directions and practical details.
scenarios.prompt: You are a traveller asking a local for directions and practical information. Ask questions, confirm what you hear and respond naturally to the answers.

scenarios.title: Telephone
scenarios.communicative_objective: Make a phone call to arrange or change an appointment and confirm the details.
scenarios.prompt: You are calling a receptionist to change an appointment. State what you need, negotiate a new time and confirm the day, time and place before ending the call.

scenarios.title: Work meeting
scenarios.communicative_objective: Present your opinion, respond to a colleague and work towards a small agreement.
scenarios.prompt: You are in a work meeting. Give your opinion on a proposal, support it with reasons, respond to a different point of view and try to reach an agreement with your colleague.

scenarios.title: Small talk
scenarios.communicative_objective: Sustain a casual conversation about everyday topics with natural turn-taking.
scenarios.prompt: You meet a new acquaintance at a social event. Start a light conversation about everyday topics, ask friendly questions and keep the conversation going naturally.

scenarios.title: Problem solving
scenarios.communicative_objective: Propose a solution to a problem, negotiate and agree on a plan.
scenarios.prompt: You and a partner have a problem to solve together. Propose a solution, explain your reasoning, respond to alternatives and negotiate until you agree on a plan.

scenarios.title: Interview
scenarios.communicative_objective: Answer questions about yourself and present your experience clearly.
scenarios.prompt: You are in a job interview. Introduce yourself, answer the interviewer's questions about your experience and ask one relevant question of your own.

scenarios.title: Introductions
scenarios.communicative_objective: Greet someone, say your name, where you are from and one thing about yourself.
scenarios.prompt: You meet someone for the first time. Say hello, introduce yourself, say where you are from and ask the other person a simple question about themselves.

scenarios.title: Bank
scenarios.communicative_objective: Open a bank account, ask about fees and give the necessary personal information.
scenarios.prompt: You are at a bank opening an account. Explain what you need, answer the clerk's questions about your details and ask about any fees or requirements.

scenarios.title: Airport
scenarios.communicative_objective: Check in for a flight, ask about your baggage and boarding information.
scenarios.prompt: You are at the airport checking in. Confirm your flight, ask about your baggage allowance and find out the gate and boarding time.

scenarios.title: Appointment
scenarios.communicative_objective: Book, change or confirm an appointment and state the date and time clearly.
scenarios.prompt: You are booking an appointment. Say what you need, choose a date and time, and confirm all the details before you finish.

scenarios.title: Housing
scenarios.communicative_objective: Ask for information about renting a flat and discuss the conditions.
scenarios.prompt: You are calling about a flat to rent. Ask about the rooms, the price, the bills and the area, and respond to what the landlord tells you.

scenarios.title: Complaint
scenarios.communicative_objective: Make a complaint clearly and reach a solution with the other person.
scenarios.prompt: You have a problem with a product or service. Explain the problem politely, say what you want as a solution and negotiate until you reach an agreement.

scenarios.title: Tech support
scenarios.communicative_objective: Describe a technical problem and follow the instructions you are given.
scenarios.prompt: You are calling technical support about a problem with your computer or phone. Describe what is wrong, answer the support person's questions and follow their steps.

scenarios.title: Small talk (advanced)
scenarios.communicative_objective: Sustain a longer casual conversation with natural follow-up questions.
scenarios.prompt: You are at a social event and meet someone new. Start a casual conversation, ask follow-up questions to keep it going and share a little about yourself.

scenarios.title: Storytelling
scenarios.communicative_objective: Tell a short story or anecdote and respond to questions about it.
scenarios.prompt: Tell someone about something interesting or funny that happened to you recently, and answer their follow-up questions naturally.

scenarios.title: Negotiation
scenarios.communicative_objective: Negotiate terms and reach an agreement that works for both sides.
scenarios.prompt: You are negotiating a deal or an agreement. State your position, respond to the other person's points and try to reach a compromise.

scenarios.title: Team presentation
scenarios.communicative_objective: Present an idea to a group and respond to questions and objections.
scenarios.prompt: You are presenting an idea to your team. Explain your proposal clearly, give reasons and respond to questions or doubts from your colleagues.

scenarios.title: Debate
scenarios.communicative_objective: Argue a point of view, counter opposing arguments and reach a reasoned conclusion.
scenarios.prompt: You are taking part in a debate. Present your point of view, support it with arguments, respond to a counter-argument and work towards a balanced conclusion.
